caption: The drawing depicts a brass ring-shaped wall-mounted candle holder. The main focus is a three-dimensional, colored rendering at the bottom right, showing a metallic gold and bronze candle holder attached to a round wall plate, with a circular ring extending downward and supporting a socket for a candle at the top. The metallic surfaces reflect light and have subtle shadings indicating curvature. At the upper left of the page, a technical drawing in pencil outlines the same object viewed from the side, with cross-sectional details of the candle socket and ring, along with measurement indicators in inches and a scale bar. The background is a lightly yellowed, textured paper, and the drawing is bordered by a single rectangular line. The name "JANET RIZA" is written at the bottom right corner.
